title: Power and Limits of Subset Selection in Statistical Estimation
summary: We study the power and limitations of subset selection in statistical estimation through the framework of \emph{super-teaching}, where a teacher selects a subset of i.i.d. data to optimize a learner's estimator. Unlike prior work focused on specific distributions or fixed subset sizes, we develop a general theory under minimal assumptions.
